question_text: A customer notices their running shoes are worn out and reads online reviews before visiting a sports store. Which stage of consumption is this?
hint: The purchase transaction has not happened yet.
correct_answer_citation: Stage 1 is Prepurchase: The consumer identifies a need and searches for information.

options.option_explanation: Correct. The consumer is identifying a need and gathering information before making a transaction.
The purchase stage occurs during the transaction, store visit, and payment.
The postpurchase stage occurs after the product is bought, while using or evaluating it.
Disposal refers to getting rid of the item at the very end of its useful life.

question_text: Why do real consumers rely on mental shortcuts instead of calculating all possible choices rationally?
hint: Think about limits on human attention, energy, and time.
correct_answer_citation: Real people have limited time and energy. They use mental shortcuts instead.

options.option_text: Because they have perfect information about every single competing brand.
options.option_explanation: Having perfect information would make calculation easier, but consumers rarely have complete data.

options.option_text: Because human beings have limited time and cognitive energy to evaluate every option.
options.option_explanation: Correct. Consumers face time and energy limits, so they rely on mental shortcuts and heuristics.

options.option_text: Because modern advertisements eliminate all uncertainty before the customer enters a store.
options.option_explanation: Ads do not remove uncertainty, and buyers still have to make choices under incomplete knowledge.

options.option_text: Because consumers only care about price and never consider brand reputations.
options.option_explanation: Consumers frequently prioritize brand loyalty, emotions, and convenience over absolute lowest price.

question_text: A brand divides its market based on whether buyers are outdoor adventure enthusiasts or indoor gaming hobbyists. What segmentation base is being used?
hint: This groups people by their lifestyles, values, and personal activities.
correct_answer_citation: Psychographics group people by lifestyle, values, and personality.

options.option_explanation: Demographics focus on objective traits like age, gender, and income.
Geographics focus on physical location, region, and climate.
Correct. Outdoor enthusiast or indoor gamer reflects lifestyle, interests, and hobbies.
Firmographics segment business organizations, not individual consumers.
